verdict.rationale: No evidence of documented support-tier SLAs, guaranteed response times, or escalation paths for different plan tiers; docs only vaguely claim support is 'run by Fly.io engineers,' with no timing commitments. Community reports (fly-io-comm-4, -5, -7, -14) even describe unresponsive or non-existent support, but since no vendor claim of guaranteed SLAs exists to contradict, this is an unmet axis rather than a dispute.
